preDeploy: test -f /opt/barakopress/.env || { echo 'no .env in /opt/barakopress: copy .env.example, fill it in, and keep it out of the sync'; exit 1; }
grep -Eq '^(PRESS_SECRET|REVALIDATE_SECRET)=.+' /opt/barakopress/.env || { echo 'PRESS_SECRET is empty, the server would refuse every delivery'; exit 1; }
grep -Eq '^SITE_PORT=[0-9]+' /opt/barakopress/.env || { echo 'SITE_PORT is missing, and compose binds it on loopback for the host proxy'; exit 1; }

n=$(grep -m1 '^EDGE_NETWORK=' /opt/barakopress/.env | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"\r'); docker network inspect "${n:-barako-edge}" >/dev/null || { echo 'the edge network does not exist: it belongs to the stack that was there first, so create it there, not here'; exit 1; }
verify: u=$(grep -m1 '^SITE_URL=' /opt/barakopress/.env | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"\r') && test -n "$u" && curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 15 "$u/" | grep -q 'href="/blog/'
